name: Rubber FM bass
desc: Rubbery FM bass in D# minor: fm(3) fmh(2.01) gives an elastic bounce with a fast bite envelope, a syncopated octave-jump cell that walks its accents one step per cycle via iter(4), and a 4-cycle i-i-VI-VII harmonic drift underneath. Sidechain-feel saw pump, 8-32 cycle filter tide, octave-up phrase-end fill at peak.

code.full: note("[d#1 ~ d#1 d#2 ~ d#1 d#2 d#1]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(${ratio}).fmattack(.005).fmdecay(.12).attack(.004).decay(.22).sustain(.16).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.28).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).iter(4).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[d#1 d#2 d#1 [~ d#1] d#2 d#1 [d#1 d#2] d#1]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(${ratio}).fmattack(.003).fmdecay(.1).attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(.14).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(5).shape(.32).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).iter(4).lastOf(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
